title: SHE: Trajectory-driven Safety Harness Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: SHE: Trajectory-driven Safety Harness Evolution for LLM Agents｜The safety of large language model (LLM) agents depends not only on model weights but also on the agent harness that

extra.description: The safety of large language model (LLM) agents depends not only on model weights but also on the agent harness that manages context, memory, tools, permissions, and runtime control. Existing safety mechanisms often treat the harness as a fixed deployment artifact, limiting their ability to evolve with emerging risks.
